question: How many customers do we have in Lahore?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = 'Lahore';

question: List the names and prices of all wallets, cheapest first.
reference_sql: SELECT name, price_pkr FROM products WHERE category = 'wallet' ORDER BY price_pkr ASC;

question: How many orders are still pending?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending';

question: What is the most expensive watch? Give its name and price.
reference_sql: SELECT name, price_pkr FROM products WHERE category = 'watch' ORDER BY price_pkr DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many orders are there in each status?
reference_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status;

question: What is the total revenue in PKR from delivered orders? Revenue is quantity times the unit price actually charged.
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_pkr) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered';

question: How many orders did each city place? Show city and number of orders.
reference_sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(o.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.city;

question: Which brand has sold the most units in total? Give the brand and the units sold.
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List the order IDs placed in August 2026.
reference_sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31';

question: What is the average list price of watches for each brand?
reference_sql: SELECT brand, AVG(price_pkr) FROM products WHERE category = 'watch' GROUP BY brand;

question: Which customers have placed more than 4 orders? Show their name and number of orders.
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 4;

question: Which products have never been ordered? Give their names.
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM order_items);

question: Who are the top 3 customers by total amount spent on delivered orders? Show name and amount spent.
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_pkr) AS spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many order lines were sold at a discount, meaning the unit price charged was lower than the product's list price?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.unit_price_pkr < p.price_pkr;

question: For each month of 2026 that has orders, how many orders were cancelled or returned? Show the month as YYYY-MM.
reference_sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY month;
